PUID.description: Puid for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

PGID.description: Pgid for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

TZ.description: Tz for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

APP_ENV.description: App env for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

APP_KEY.description: Generated 32-character Laravel encryption key. Preserve with the SQLite database; changing it invalidates encrypted application data.

APP_URL.description: App url resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

APP_DEBUG.description: App debug for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

DB_CONNECTION.description: Db connection for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

PUBLIC_DASHBOARD.description: Public dashboard for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

SPEEDTEST_SCHEDULE.description: Automatic speed tests are disabled initially. Tests measure Railway regional egress, not your home Internet, and can consume billable bandwidth. Set a cron schedule only after a manual test.

PRUNE_RESULTS_OLDER_THAN.description: Remove speed-test results older than 90 days using the upstream scheduler.

UPSTREAM_HOST.description: Upstream host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

UPSTREAM_PORT.description: Upstream port for speedtest-tracker. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_AUTH.description: Owner auth for speedtest-tracker. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_SCOPE.description: Owner scope for speedtest-tracker. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Generated access password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.
